name: Chinohate Slow Life: Ney x Pell Hen
original_name: ちのはてすろーらいふ ネイ×ペル編
source:
Ney, a low-level demon from the second layer of Hell, was reluctant to talk to anyone, and his only friend was his messenger, Hebitan. Then, at a social gathering, he meets Pell, a demon from the sixth layer, and falls in love with him at first sight. 
He is approached by Pell and they become close friends, and his life changes completely. Unexpectedly, he got acquainted with demons from other levels and made friends with them as well.

Time passes...
Ney continues to visit Pell as usual.
With Hebitan in tow, he was supposed to go about his daily life...without any changes.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ322406.html/]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
来自地狱第二层的低阶恶魔内伊不愿与人交谈，唯一的朋友就是自己的信使Hebitan。直到某次聚会上，他遇见了来自第六层的恶魔佩尔，并对他一见钟情。
佩尔主动接近内伊，两人成了亲密好友，内伊的生活也随之彻底改变。出乎意料的是，他还结识了其他层级的恶魔，与他们成为朋友。

时光流逝……
内伊依旧照常去拜访佩尔。
带着Hebitan，他原本以为，自己会继续过着毫无变化的日常生活……
